title: Remote enterprise workstation onboarding
goal: A real laptop joins the company network from outside the lab, with the right access for each person.
built: A physical Windows 11 Pro laptop, NOVA-LAP01, with its own WireGuard staff VPN peer that reconnects after a reboot
The laptop joined to nova.corp, placed in the Workstations OU, with a healthy machine secure channel
Kerberos sign-in and time sync checked from outside the lab
One narrow, logged firewall rule: TCP 445 from the laptop to FILES01 only. RDP and WinRM stay blocked
A final encrypted pfSense backup, copied off the host with a matching SHA-256 hash
validated: Moyo gets the IT drive automatically and can create, read, change and delete a test file there. Four other departments' folders are denied to her. The contractor John gets no drive and is denied all five. A real USB flash drive worked for Moyo and was denied to John. Firewall logs show SMB allowed and RDP and WinRM blocked.
limits: Full management-plane isolation was not done. Proxmox sits on the home network, and a laptop on that network can reach it. That is CR-016.
A restore was not performed. The matching hash shows the copy is intact, not that it restores.
Whether the VPN connects before sign-in was not tested.
How the drive mapping was applied after the restart was not inspected, so no policy root cause is claimed.
The USB test used one flash drive. It does not cover every kind of external disk.
